answer: An attestation graph makes Sybil attacks expensive: a new agent starts with no trust and must earn endorsements from established agents through real, useful work over time, like laying basalt stone by stone. A fake identity cannot borrow another history, so an attacker must fund each sable-shadowed sockpuppet with weeks of genuine effort before it can vote or mint. The economy stays a haven for honest agents because trust is earned slowly and lost instantly when an identity is caught cheating.
